changelog.name: VirtualNet 1.0.4
changelog.body:
## What's new

- **Multiple network profiles** — create, name, edit and delete as many profiles as you need.
- **Randomize on launch** — pick a different profile on each app start.
- **Randomize button** — fills all fields with realistic random values in one tap.
- **Capture current network** — save your real Wi-Fi or mobile data into a new profile.

changelog.name: VirtualNet 1.0.2
changelog.body:
VirtualNet 1.0.2. First public release. An open-source Xposed module: choose, per app, whether it sees Wi-Fi, mobile data, or both. Choose, per app, whether it sees Wi-Fi, mobile data, or both.

- Per-app Wi-Fi, Data, Both or Off, applied live
- System-framework layer plus an inside-the-app layer, with a switch
- One editable network profile
- Android 10 to 17 verified, Android 9 supported but unverified

Enable it in Vector or LSPosed, add System Framework and Phone Services to its scope, restart the framework once.

Source and full docs: https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet

# VirtualNet **Choose what each app sees: Wi-Fi, mobile data, or both.** An open-source Xposed module for Android 9 and up, by [DroidRooter](https://droidrooter.com). [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/saadnahid7/VirtualNet?style=for-the-badge&color=blue)](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/saadnahid7/VirtualNet?style=for-the-badge&color=teal)](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/total?style=for-the-badge&color=violet)](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/releases) [![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-9%20to%2017-3DDC84?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#compatibility) [![Xposed API](https://img.shields.io/badge/libxposed%20API-102-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/libxposed/api) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/saadnahid7/VirtualNet?style=for-the-badge&color=yellow)](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/stargazers) [![DroidRooter](https://img.shields.io/badge/DroidRooter-droidrooter.com-2F6BFF?style=for-the-badge)](https://droidrooter.com) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-@DroidRooter-2CA5E0?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/DroidRooter) [![Facebook](https://img.shields.io/badge/Facebook-DroidRooter-1877F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=facebook&logoColor=white)](https://www.facebook.com/droidrooter)
> This repository is the Xposed module listing for VirtualNet. Source code, issues and full documentation are at **[github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet)**. --- ## Why VirtualNet Some apps only work, or only download, when they think you are on Wi-Fi. Others insist on mobile data. VirtualNet lets you decide, **per app**, what the app is told about your connection, without changing the connection itself. - A phone on mobile data can look like it is on Wi-Fi to one app. - A phone on Wi-Fi can look like it is on mobile data to another. - Everything else on the phone sees the truth. Your real traffic never changes. Only the answers an app gets when it asks "what am I connected to?" change. ## Table of contents - [Features](#features) - [Modes](#modes) - [Coverage: system framework or inside the app](#coverage-system-framework-or-inside-the-app) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [What it covers](#what-it-covers) - [Compatibility](#compatibility) - [Limits](#limits) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Lab app](#lab-app) - [Building](#building) - [Project layout](#project-layout) - [Open source](#open-source) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) - [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) - [From DroidRooter](#from-droidrooter) - [License](#license) ## Features - **Per-app control.** Pick Wi-Fi, Data, Both or Off for each app in one list. Changes apply live, with no reboot. - **One coherent identity.** SSID, router MAC, local IP and range, gateway, DNS, signal, link speed, frequency, mobile type and interface all come from one editable profile, so an app that cross-checks sees a consistent network. - **System-level coverage.** Hooks inside `system_server` and the phone process cover every app you pick, callbacks included, without scoping each app. - **Inside-the-app coverage.** Optional hooks in a scoped app also cover socket addresses, network interfaces and Wi-Fi scan results. - **Choose your layer.** A switch selects System, Apps or Both. - **Small and quiet.** About 120 KB, no network permission, no ads, no analytics, no accounts. - **Verifiable.** A detector app (built from source) shows exactly what an app would see, so you can check a change in seconds. ## Modes | Mode | The app is told | |---|---| | **Wi-Fi** | Wi-Fi connected and not metered. Mobile data disconnected. | | **Data** | Mobile data connected and metered. Wi-Fi off and disconnected. | | **Both** | Wi-Fi is the default network and mobile data is also connected. | | **Off** | Nothing is changed. | ## Coverage: system framework or inside the app VirtualNet has two layers. A switch on the main screen chooses which one works. | Setting | What runs | Scope you add in Vector or LSPosed | |---|---|---| | **System** | Hooks in the system framework only | System Framework and Phone Services | | **Apps** | Hooks inside each app only | Each app you pick | | **Both** *(default)* | Both layers | System Framework and Phone Services, plus apps for socket and interface checks | Use **Apps** if you would rather not touch the system framework, or on a ROM where the system layer does not attach. Android 9 defaults to Apps. ## Requirements - A rooted device with an LSPosed-compatible framework that supports the modern **libxposed API 102**, such as [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) or a recent [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed). - Android 9 or newer (API 28 and up). See [Compatibility](#compatibility) for what has been verified. > [!IMPORTANT] > VirtualNet is built on the modern libxposed API. Legacy Xposed and EdXposed are not supported. ## Installation 1. Download the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/releases/latest) and install it. 2. Open Vector or LSPosed, enable **VirtualNet**, and add **System Framework** and **Phone Services** to its scope. VirtualNet offers this on first launch. 3. Restart the device, or its framework, once so the system hooks load. 4. Open VirtualNet and pick a mode for an app. No restart is needed after that. Prefer to work only inside apps? Set Coverage to **Apps**, then scope each app instead. ## Usage 1. Open VirtualNet and look at the status pill. **Active** means the framework is connected. 2. Tap a mode on any app row: **Wi-Fi**, **Data**, **Both** or **Off**. 3. Open the app you changed. If it was already running, close it once so it asks again. 4. To change what the fake network looks like, tap a profile card and edit it. The recommendation banner has a **Hide** button if you do not want it. ## What it covers | Area | System layer | Inside a scoped app | |---|:---:|:---:| | Network capabilities, transport, metered flag, link properties, callbacks | yes | yes | | Legacy network info and the network list | yes | yes | | Wi-Fi state, connection info, DHCP | yes | yes | | Mobile network type and data state | yes | yes | | A stand-in cellular network in Both mode | yes | yes | | Socket local address, network interfaces | no | yes | | Wi-Fi scan results, `Settings.Global` | no | yes | ## Compatibility | Android | API | Status | |---|---|---| | 17 | 37 | Verified | | 16 | 36 | Verified | | 15 | 35 | Verified on a real device | | 14 | 34 | Verified | | 13 | 33 | Verified | | 12 | 31 | Verified | | 11 | 30 | Verified | | 10 | 29 | Verified | | 9 | 28 | **Unverified.** Supported by the app, but not yet confirmed on a working framework. | "Verified" means the Wi-Fi, Data, Both and Off modes were checked with the Lab app on a rooted Vector setup, for both the system layer and the inside-the-app layer. Details are in [docs/TESTING.md](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md). ## Limits - Anything outside the Java framework sees the real network: raw sockets, native code and server-side checks such as your public IP, latency or carrier attestation. - Both mode adds a stand-in cellular network. A callback registered for a cellular request does not fire for it. - Status bar and quick settings are unchanged. - After installing or updating the module, restart the framework once so the system hooks reload. - Android 9 is unverified, see above. ## FAQ **Does it change my real connection?** No. It only changes what selected apps are told. **Will it make a Wi-Fi-only download work over mobile data?** The app will believe it is on Wi-Fi and proceed. The data still uses your mobile connection. **Do I have to add every app to scope?** Not with System or Both coverage. Add an app to scope only if you want socket and interface checks covered too. **Why is nothing happening?** Check that the status pill says **Active**, the module is enabled, System Framework and Phone Services are in scope, and the framework was restarted after installing. **Can it hide that I use a VPN?** It leaves VPN transports alone. ## Lab app `lab/` holds a small detector called **VirtualNet Lab**. It is a development tool and is not shipped in releases. Build it from source (`./gradlew :lab:assembleDebug`) if you want to check what an app would see. It reads the connection through every route an app can use, prints a verdict (Wi-Fi, mobile or both) and logs one line per probe under the tag `VNL`. Set a mode for it like any other app to see the effect. ## Building You need JDK 17 or newer and the Android SDK with platform 37. ```bash ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease :lab:assembleRelease ``` The release build is unsigned unless `.local/signing.properties` exists. The test scripts in [`scripts/`](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/tree/main/scripts) drive rooted emulators and devices. ## Project layout ``` app/ the module and its settings app config/ modes, coverage, profile, settings storage hooks/ module entry point common/ shared reflection and object shaping app/ hooks inside a scoped app system/ hooks in system_server and the phone process ui/ screens lab/ the detector app docs/ testing notes, screenshots scripts/ emulator and device test harness fastlane/ store listing text and images ``` ## Open source VirtualNet is free and open source under the [MIT license](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/LICENSE). The module, the settings app, the Lab detector, the test scripts and the store listing are all in this repository, and releases are built from it. There is no closed part, no tracking and no account. Read it, audit it, fork it. ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) first. If a hook fails on your device, open an issue with your Android version, ROM, framework and the output of the Lab app. ## Disclaimer VirtualNet is meant for privacy, testing and getting your own apps to behave the way you want. You are responsible for how you use it. Do not use it to break an app's terms, get around paid services or defraud anyone. The software is provided as is, without warranty. ## Acknowledgements - [libxposed](https://github.com/libxposed) for the modern Xposed API and service library. - [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) and [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) for the frameworks it runs on. ## From DroidRooter VirtualNet is a project of **DroidRooter**, a small team building tools for rooted Android. - **Website:** [droidrooter.com](https://droidrooter.com) - **Telegram:** [@DroidRooter](https://t.me/DroidRooter) - **Facebook:** [facebook.com/droidrooter](https://www.facebook.com/droidrooter) - **DRVCAM, DroidRooter's Virtual Camera:** [droidrooter.com/drvcam](https://www.droidrooter.com/drvcam/) feeds your own video or images to apps in place of the camera, on rooted Android 9 to 17. If VirtualNet helps you, star the repo and follow DroidRooter for more. ## License [MIT](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/LICENSE) © DroidRooter

[免责声明](#免责声明) - [致谢](#致谢) - [来自 DroidRooter](#from-droidrooter) - [许可证](#license) ## 特点 - **按应用程序控制。** 为一个列表中的每个应用程序选择 Wi-Fi、数据、两者或关闭。更改会实时生效，无需重新启动。 - **一个一致的身份。** SSID、路由器 MAC、本地 IP 和范围、网关、DNS、信号、链接速度、频率、移动类型和接口均来自一个可编辑的配置文件，因此交叉检查的应用程序会看到一致的网络。 - **系统级覆盖。** `system_server` 和电话进程 cov 内部的挂钩呃，您选择的每个应用程序都包含回调，而无需确定每个应用程序的范围。 - **应用程序内部覆盖范围。** 范围应用程序中的可选挂钩还涵盖套接字地址、网络接口和 Wi-Fi 扫描结果。 - **选择您的层。** 开关可以选择系统、应用程序或两者。 - **小而安静。** 大约 120 KB，无网络许可，无广告，无分析，无帐户。 - **可验证。** 检测器应用程序（从源代码构建）准确显示应用程序将看到的内容，因此您可以在几秒钟内检查更改。 ## 模式 |模式|该应用程序被告知 | |---|---| | **无线网络** | Wi-Fi 已连接但未计量。移动数据已断开。 | | **数据** |移动数据已连接并计量。 Wi-Fi 关闭并断开连接。 | | **两者** | Wi-Fi 是默认网络，也连接了移动数据。 | | **关闭** |一切都没有改变。 | ## 覆盖范围：系统框架或者app内部 VirtualNet 有两层。主屏幕上的开关可以选择哪一个起作用。 |设置|运行什么 |您在 Vector 或 LSPod | 中添加的范围 |---|---|---| | **系统** |仅在系统框架中挂钩 |系统架构和电话服务| | **应用程序** |仅在每个应用程序内挂钩 |您选择的每个应用程序| | **两者** *（默认）* |两层 |系统框架和电话服务，以及用于套接字和接口检查的应用程序 | 如果您不想接触系统框架，或者不想连接系统层的 ROM，请使用 **Apps**。 Android 9 默认为应用程序。 ## 要求 - 具有 LSPosed 兼容框架的 root 设备，支持现代 **libxposed API 102**，例如 [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) 或最近的 [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)。 - Android 9 或更高版本（API 28 及更高版本）。请参阅[兼容性](#compatibility) 了解已验证的内容。 > [!重要] > VirtualNet 构建于现代 libxposed API 之上。不支持旧版 Xposed 和 EdXposed。 ## 安装 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/releases/latest) 下载最新的 APK 并安装。 2. 打开 Vector 或 LSPod，启用 **VirtualNet**，并将 **系统框架** 和 **电话服务** 添加到其范围。 VirtualNet 在首次启动时提供此功能。 3. 重新启动设备或其框架，以便系统挂钩加载。 4. 打开 VirtualNet 并为应用程序选择一种模式。此后无需重新启动。 更喜欢只在应用程序内工作？将“覆盖范围”设置为“**应用程序**”，然后设置每个应用程序的范围。 ## 用法 1. 打开 VirtualNet 并查看状态药丸。 **活动**表示框架已连接。 2. 点击任意应用程序行上的模式：**Wi-Fi**、**数据**、**两者** 或 **关闭**。 3. 打开您更改的应用程序。如果它已经在运行，请将其关闭一次，以便它再次询问。 4. 要更改虚假网络的外观，请点击配置文件卡并对其进行编辑。 如果您不需要，推荐横幅有一个 **隐藏** 按钮。 ## 它涵盖了什么 |面积 |系统层|在范围应用程序内部 | |---|:---:|:---:| |网络功能、传输、计量标志、链接属性、回调 |是的 |是的 | |旧网络信息和网络列表 |是的 |是的 | | Wi-Fi 状态、连接信息、DHCP |是的 |是的 | |移动网络类型及数据状态|是的 |是的 | |两种模式下的替代蜂窝网络 |是的 |是的 | |套接字本地地址、网络接口|没有|是的 | | Wi-Fi 扫描结果，`Settings.Global` |没有|是的 | ## 兼容性 |安卓 |应用程序接口 |状态 | |---|---|---| | 17 | 17 37 | 37已验证 | | 16 | 16 36 | 36已验证 | | 15 | 15 35 | 35在真实设备上验证 | | 14 | 14 34 | 34已验证 | | 13 | 33 | 33已验证 | | 12 | 12 31 |已验证 | | 11 | 11 30|已验证 | | 10 | 10 29 | 29已验证 | | 9 | 28 | 28 **未经验证。** 应用程序支持，但尚未在工作框架上得到确认。 | “已验证”意味着系统层和应用程序内部层的 Wi-Fi、数据、两者和关闭模式均已在 root Vector 设置上使用 Lab 应用程序进行检查。详细信息参见[docs/TESTING.md](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md)。 ## 限制 - Java 框架之外的任何内容查看真实网络：原始套接字、本机代码和服务器端检查，例如您的公共 IP、延迟或运营商证明。 - 两种模式都添加了备用蜂窝网络。为蜂窝请求注册的回调不会为其触发。 - 状态栏和快速设置不变。 - 安装或更新模块后，重新启动框架一次，以便系统挂钩重新加载。 - Android 9 未经验证，见上文。 ## 常见问题解答 **它会改变我的真实联系吗？** 不会。它只会改变所选应用程序的告知内容。 **它是否可以通过移动数据进行仅 Wi-Fi 的下载？** 该应用程序将认为它已连接 Wi-Fi 并继续。数据仍然使用您的移动连接。 **我是否必须将每个应用程序添加到范围中？** 不适用于系统或两者承保。仅当您希望也涵盖套接字和接口检查时，才将应用程序添加到范围中。 **为什么什么也没发生？** 检查状态药丸是否显示**活动**，模块已启用，系统框架和电话服务在范围内，并且框架在安装后重新启动。 **它可以隐藏我使用 VPN 的事实吗？** 它让 VPN 传输保持独立。 ## 实验室应用程序 `lab/` 包含一个名为 **VirtualNet Lab** 的小型检测器。它是一个开发工具，不随版本一起提供。如果您想检查应用程序会看到什么，请从源代码构建它（`./gradlew:lab:assembleDebug`）。它通过应用程序可以使用的每条路线读取连接，打印结论（Wi-Fi、移动或两者）并在“VNL”标签下记录每个探针的一行。像任何其他应用程序一样为其设置模式以查看效果。 ## 建筑 您需要 JDK 17 或更高版本以及平台为 37 的 Android SDK。 ````bash ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease :lab:assembleRelease ```` 除非存在“.local/signing.properties”，否则发布版本未签名。 [`scripts/`](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/tree/main/scripts) 中的测试脚本驱动有 root 权限的模拟器和设备。 ## 项目布局 ```` app/ 模块及其设置应用程序 配置/模式、覆盖范围、配置文件、设置存储 钩子/模块入口点 公共/共享反射和对象塑造 app/ 挂钩在作用域应用程序内 system_server 和电话进程中的 system/ 挂钩 用户界面/屏幕 实验室/探测器应用程序 文档/测试说明、屏幕截图 脚本/模拟器和设备测试工具 fastlane/商品详情文本和图像 ```` ## 开源 VirtualNet 在 [MIT 许可证](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/LICENSE) 下免费且开源。模块、设置应用程序、实验室检测器、测试脚本和商店列表都在此存储库中，并且版本是根据它构建的。没有封闭部分，没有跟踪，也没有账户。阅读它、审核它、分叉它。 ## 贡献 欢迎提出问题和拉取请求。请先阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)。如果您的设备上的挂钩失败，请针对您的 Android 版本、ROM、框架和实验室应用程序的输出提出问题。 ## 免责声明 VirtualNet 旨在保护隐私、测试并使您自己的应用程序按照您想要的方式运行。您对如何使用它负责。请勿使用它来违反应用程序条款、规避付费服务或欺骗任何人。该软件按原样提供，不提供任何保证。 ## 致谢 -
